business_summary: Chipsea Technologies (Shenzhen) Corp., Ltd. researches, designs, and sells integrated circuits in China and internationally. It offers chips, algorithms, application solutions, and AIoT chips to support smart terminals, smart homes, computers, and ICT, as well as analog signal chain and MCU chips. Chipsea Technologies (Shenzhen) Corp., Ltd. was formerly known as Shenzhen Xinhai Technology Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Chipsea Technologies (Shenzhen) Corp., Ltd. in November 2015. Chipsea Technologies (Shenzhen) Corp., Ltd. was incorporated in 2003 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
business_summary_ko: Chipsea Technologies (Shenzhen) Corp., Ltd.는 중국 및 국제적으로 집적 회로를 연구, 설계 및 판매합니다. 스마트 단말기, 스마트 홈, 컴퓨터, ICT를 지원하는 칩, 알고리즘, 응용 솔루션, AIoT 칩은 물론 아날로그 신호 체인 및 MCU 칩도 제공합니다. Chipsea Technologies (Shenzhen) Corp., Ltd.는 이전에 Shenzhen Xinhai Technology Co., Ltd.로 알려졌으며 2015년 11월에 Chipsea Technologies (Shenzhen) Corp., Ltd.로 이름을 변경했습니다. Chipsea Technologies (Shenzhen) Corp., Ltd.는 2003년에 설립되었으며 중국 심천에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
